text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — planning a gradual rollout for the client bindings (v2.5.0) this Thursday 22:00 UTC. This is a minor release: no protocol-breaking changes, but we do rename the `X-Request-Meta` header to `X-RW-Meta` and change the default `Accept` handling for the streaming endpoint. Will roll as staged canaries (5% -> 25% -> 100%) over ~45m. Need smoke owners + rollback owner. changelog: https://go/release/clients/v2.5 :wave:

mike: I can own the canary smoke for the gateway side. Quick checklist: validate streaming handshake, header passthrough, and quota headers. :+1:

ashwin: I flagged one compatibility note in the PR — some older SDKs that relied on the old header name will continue to work (we added mapping) but we should surface a deprecation notice in the response headers for one month. Also reminder: telemetry schema v3 arrives in next patch, not this rollout.

emily: I'll run the Python SDK smoke tests and verify examples/quickstart. ETA Thu 21:30 UTC to finish preflight.

jordan: I'll take JS and mobile integration sanity. Do we have a canned test for partial failures (simulate kv-cache miss)?

ryan: For rollback plan: if we see error rate > 3% or latency tail spike > 250ms for 5m on canary, revert to previous deployment. Revert steps (short):
```
1) patch api-gateway routing -> point canary buckets to v2.4
2) disable client-bindings v2.5 flag in rollout service
3) trigger quick healthcheck script: /ops/scripts/smoke-client-bindings.sh
```
I can be on-call to execute if needed.

dev-bot: Deploy pipeline scheduled: build 5487 -> canary 02:00:00 UTC window Thu. Logs: https://ci/reports/5487

sre-oncall: I'll monitor infra metrics and paging. Add me to any incident threads. Also confirm K8s poddisruptionbudget is set for the binding pods (we saw a flaky eviction last month).

mike: one more ask — client communications. Product wants a short note for customers who pin to header name. Suggest we add a 2-line blurb in the SDK release notes and an in-console banner for 30 days. emily/jordan can you draft?

emily: I'll draft the Python blurb, push to docs PR by Wed EOD.

jordan: I'll draft JS/mobile lines too.

olivia: Great — owners: canary smoke = mike, python = emily, js/mobile = jordan, rollback executor = ryan, infra monitor = sre-oncall. I'll publish release calendar entry and send the client email template to product for review. Please acknowledge if you see any blocker by Wed 12:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

mike: ack

emily: ack

jordan: ack

olivia: If anyone wants to run an extra compatibility sweep against older SDKs (v1.x), ping me — we can open a quick integration slot Wed afternoon.

ashwin: noted — will run the header-mapping regression locally and post results here.

dev-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2480003400 — preflight smoke run (automated).

ryan: I'll drop the rollback snippet into the runbook and link it in the release calendar.

olivia: Thanks all — closing the loop here.
